description.en: Session archiving with cross-session long-term memory: keeps the last few sessions per channel, retires stale un-prefixed sessions, and maintains a LONGTERM.md handed to the next session. Keywords: archive, long-term memory, session cleanup. MIT.
description.zh: 会话归档 + 跨会话长期记忆：按渠道保留最近几轮，无前缀旧会话到期自动归档；每轮维护一份 LONGTERM.md 交给下一个会话。关键词：会话归档 archive、长期记忆 memory、清理会话。MIT。
